name: strudel-rack
title: StrudelRack
description: Studio hardware generated from Strudel code: a rack of devices, one per track, with mute/solo pads, a channel fader, synth and key LCDs, TR-style step keys for the mini-notation and LED-ring knobs for each effect. Every control edits the code in place. Knob, Fader and StepGrid are exported on their own.
